notes:
v1.0.39 — Modrinth-first search with automatic CurseForge fallback.

Searching the Modrinth tab now never dead-ends: if Modrinth has no match
for your search term, the launcher automatically runs the same search in
CurseForge and shows those results with a clear banner ("No Modrinth
results — showing X matches from CurseForge instead"). Modrinth stays the
priority — results only come from CurseForge when Modrinth truly has none
(and no category filter is active). Installing from the fallback list
works exactly the same way.

Also confirmed: the Fabric API is always installed from Modrinth
(api.modrinth.com) — creating a Fabric profile never touches CurseForge.
